_descriptions.gains_bro: Feeling swole and ready to flex on haters
_descriptions.hydrated_for_once: A miraculous state of proper bodily function
_descriptions.manic: Heart racing, vision blurring, feeling unstoppable
_descriptions.heart_palpitations: Your heart beats in morse code: S.O.S.
_descriptions.hardcore_gamer: Committed to the grind, ignoring basic human needs
_descriptions.hungover: Everything hurts and the sun is your enemy
_descriptions.sloppy: Hand-eye coordination has left the building
_descriptions.embarrassed: Wishing you could disappear into the crowd
_descriptions.grease_fingers: Everything slips from your butter-coated hands
_descriptions.broke_af: Your wallet echoes when you shake it
_descriptions.tourist_trap_victim: You might as well wear a sign that says 'ROB ME'
_descriptions.the_herp: It's poison ivy. There was DEFINITELY foliage at that beach party
_descriptions.food_poisoning: Your digestive system has declared war
_descriptions.lost_af: Everything looks the same when you're this confused
_descriptions.reputation_ruined: Word travels fast in small Euromemeian districts
_descriptions.caffeine_crash: Your body demands payment for that artificial energy
_descriptions.blackout_drunk: The last thing you remember was ordering 'just one more'
_descriptions.crash: What goes up must come crashing down
_descriptions.existential_crisis: What am I doing with my life?
